title: map list views have no authorable config surface — `ListViewSchema` declares no `map` block, so marker titles fall back to a field name the object does not have
body:
Found while implementing #4941 (camera fit). Filed unassigned, not claiming.

## The gap

`@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` `src/ui/view.zod.ts` — `ListViewSchema` is a `strictObject` and declares a per-visualization config block for **seven** of the nine view types:

```
kanban / calendar / gantt / gallery / timeline / chart / tree
```

There is no `map` block, and no `center` / `zoom` / camera slot anywhere on the schema. The showcase already records this in a comment next to its own visualization switcher (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts`): "map needs a spec MapConfigSchema the ListViewSchema doesn't yet have".

Meanwhile `plugin-map` reads its configuration from `schema.map` — a registered component input (`packages/plugin-map/src/index.tsx`, `{ name: 'map', type: 'object' }`), documented as an authoring surface in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx` (`latitudeField`, `longitudeField`, `locationField`, `titleField`, `descriptionField`, `zoom`, `center`) and validated by a local zod schema in `ObjectMap.tsx`.

So the renderer has a config block, the platform metadata contract does not. An object list view of `type: 'map'` cannot declare one: the container schema is strict, so the key is not authorable there at all.

## What that costs today (showcase `task`, "Work Locations (Map)")

The view is `{ label, type: 'map', data, columns: ['title', 'location', 'assignee'] }` — everything else is unauthorable, so `getMapConfig` returns its field-name defaults: `latitude` / `longitude` / `location` / `name` / `description`.

- Coordinates render only by coincidence: the default `locationField` is `location`, which happens to be the seed's field name.
- `titleField` defaults to `name`, and `showcase_task` has **`title`**, not `name`. Every marker's title is therefore `undefined`: the popup heading renders empty, the mobile record sheet renders empty, and the map's search box (which matches on title/description) matches nothing at all.
- `columns` is deliberately NOT mapped into the map's config (see the note in `index.tsx`), so declaring `columns: ['title', ...]` does not name the title field either.

An author looking at that map has no spec-legal way to fix it.

## Direction (contract-first, not a renderer workaround)

Declare the block in the spec — a map config member on `ListViewSchema`, next to the other seven — and let `plugin-map` read a declared surface. Two things NOT to do: teach the renderer to guess a title field, or accept the config under some other already-declared key. Both would fossilize a second de-facto contract (AGENTS.md #0.1).

Note that the enabling change lands in `@objectstack/spec` (objectstack repo); this issue is filed here because the observable defect and the reader of the missing declaration both live in this repo.

## Not this

#4941 / PR #5000 (initial camera fits the queried records) deliberately did NOT invent a config key: it derives the camera from the data when nothing is declared, and keeps the documented plugin-level `zoom` / `center` winning when it is. That fix is orthogonal to this gap — it makes the *camera* work without a declaration; the *field mapping* still cannot be declared on a list view.
